notes: M5 local implementation and its immutable reviewed evidence remain valid. Current staging evidence adds a clean v0.1.30 40-case aggregate pass, one later control-plane abort, and two complete repeats that each contain one distinct system failure despite passing aggregate thresholds. Repeatability is therefore still open. Continue with targeted provider/fallback failure analysis, a sanitized representative enterprise corpus with reviewed labels, provider revision and cost inputs, managed observability ownership, and representative capacity evidence before another full-suite run. These are active manual-gate tasks on the current delivery path; only M6-R5 requires another server or independent fault domain.
